info.name: Local Service Finder System API
info.description:
Comprehensive Postman collection for Local Service Finder System backend APIs built with Django REST Framework.

### Authentication Flow
1. Use **User Signin** in *1. Authentication & Accounts* to log in.
2. The collection automatically captures `access_token` and `refresh_token` into collection variables.
3. Endpoints requiring authentication will automatically use the `Bearer {{access_token}}` token.

### Base URL
- Default: `http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/v1`
